timing_notes: Sequential fresh processes/Workers; all correctness producers terminal before timing.
3 warmups,11 batches of120 iterations,seeded identical fixtures.

Very small Chrome conversion times are sensitive to timer quantization.
No library-wide speedup claim; small-model training has additional management cost.
Node float64 AdamW baseline is slower than the Chrome baseline; do not infer a consistent float64 gain.
